effect_description_eng:
[Main] You may play 1 [Sangomon] or [Yao Qinglan] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Yao Qinglan] suspend, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・1 of your Digimon with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits may digivolve into an [Aquatic] and [LIBERATOR] trait Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
